gates.reason: Produces fixed synthetic in-memory artifacts only; no filesystem access, network/LLM egress, credentials, HTML injection sink, or command execution.
A model-routing recommendation claims confirmation across both batches, but only one batch contains the cited comparison.
Corpus assembly is deterministic and bounded to a fixed 18-session build-time sample; no request-time or unbounded ingest path is present.
The sole write target is a fixed module-relative path; neither the path nor archived entries accept user input, preventing traversal or command injection.
Manual serialization wrapper; it defines no detector, parser, recommendation claim, validated fix, or substantive calculation.
Synchronous compression and writing operate once over the fixed bounded sample corpus in a manual, non-build script.
Uses randomized temporary directories, fixed child-process argv, loopback-only HTTP, explicit LLM-egress disable flags and empty API/token overrides, and removes only its own resolved temp paths.
Route-cache integration test; it emits no recommendation, detector/parser result, validated fix snippet, or user-facing historical claim.
Provides a bounded probe for single-flight behavior, warm-cache hits, distinct keys, and source-change invalidation using eight concurrent requests.

findings.title: Synthetic routing recommendation asserts nonexistent cross-batch confirmation
findings.what: The haiku-to-sonnet failure recommendation says its quality gap "holds across both batches." The first artifact is the only batch containing `gap:haiku-sonnet:failure:small`; the second batch exclusively evaluates `gap:sonnet-opus:*`. The displayed recommendation therefore overstates its structured evidence and is not reproducible from the emitted artifacts.
findings.fix: Change the rationale to describe support from the single 12-task replay batch, or add a second independently evidenced haiku-to-sonnet batch before retaining the cross-batch claim.
findings.acceptance: Inspect `buildSampleModelEvalResults()` and verify every batch cited by the recommendation contains candidate and baseline runs for `gap:haiku-sonnet:failure:small`; alternatively, verify the rationale no longer claims multi-batch confirmation and cites the existing 11/12 versus 7/12 evidence.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed lines 807-880 contain one haiku-to-sonnet batch and the challenged recommendation, while lines 888-955 contain only sonnet-to-opus scopes; no second supporting batch exists in the emitted result set.
